spec.title: Model
spec.description: Model of the GPUs in this server.

spec.title: GPUs
spec.description:
Number of GPUs reporting in this server. MIG instances, the slices a GPU can be split into, are not counted.

Selected: the number of GPUs picked in the GPU list, shown only when it is not all of them.

spec.expr:
count(max by (hw_gpu_index) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", state="present"}) == 1)
or (0 * count(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", state="present"}))

count(max by (hw_gpu_index) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_index=~"$gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", state="present"}) == 1)
unless on () (count(max by (hw_gpu_index) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_index=~"$gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", state="present"}) == 1) == count(max by (hw_gpu_index) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", state="present"}) == 1))

spec.title: Driver
spec.description:
Version of the NVIDIA driver on this server.

Not reported: the exporter does not send the driver version, or the connector does not publish it yet.

spec.expr: count by (driver_version) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", state="present", driver_version!=""})

spec.title: Memory per GPU
spec.description: Memory of each GPU in this server. The largest one is shown if they differ.

spec.expr: max(hw_gpu_memory_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id=""})

spec.title: Power Limit per GPU
spec.description: Most power each GPU in this server is allowed to draw. The highest one is shown if they differ.

spec.expr: max(hw_power_limit_watts{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu"})

spec.title: Connector
spec.description:
Whether the agent can read the GPU data through the NVIDIA DCGM Exporter connector.

Stale: nothing came from the agent for this server in the last 5 minutes. Last Collect shows when data last came.

spec.expr:
max(metricshub_connector_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", state="ok"})
or on () (0 * max(last_over_time(metricshub_connector_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", state="ok"}[$__range])) - 1)

spec.title: Exporter
spec.description:
Whether the agent can reach the NVIDIA DCGM exporter on this server.

Stale: nothing came from the agent for this server in the last 5 minutes. Last Collect shows when data last came.

spec.expr:
min(metricshub_host_up{host_name="$host_name", protocol="http"})
or on () (0 * min(last_over_time(metricshub_host_up{host_name="$host_name", protocol="http"}[$__range])) - 1)

spec.title: Last Collect
spec.description: When the agent last sent GPU data for this server, within the selected period.

spec.expr: max(timestamp(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name="$host_name", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", state="present"})) * 1000

spec.description:
Average of the selected GPUs over time. The streaming multiprocessors (SMs) are the parts of the GPU that run the jobs.

SM activity: share of time the SMs had work.

SM occupancy: how full the SMs were, as a share of the threads they can hold at once.

High activity with low occupancy means the SMs are busy but run little work at once, so the job does not use the GPU well. It is worth profiling.

Both lines average the GPUs that report both figures, so that they compare the same GPUs. When no GPU reports both, each line averages the GPUs that report it, and its name ends with "no GPU reports both".

Not reported: the GPUs do not report these profiling figures.

spec.title: Reliability
spec.description:
Errors and memory wear of each selected GPU. The error counts cover the selected period, the memory figures are the GPU's state right now. A cell is colored only when it is not zero.

XID: faults reported by the NVIDIA driver. Most are a crashed job, some point to a failing GPU.

ECC Uncorrected: memory errors the GPU could not correct. They can crash a job.

ECC Corrected: memory errors the GPU corrected. A few are routine, a rising count points to failing memory.

NVLink and PCIe: transmission errors on the GPU's connections.

Remapped Rows and Uncorrected Rows: memory rows the GPU replaced with spares after errors, all of them and those after uncorrected errors.

Banks Low and Banks at None: memory banks with few or no spare rows left. Errors in a bank with none left cannot be repaired.

Memory Conditions: memory problems the GPU reports right now.

Not reported: the GPU sends no value, for example a figure the connector does not publish yet.

spec.title: NVLink Ports
spec.description:
The NVSwitch ports that lead to the selected GPUs, one NVLink connection each. With all GPUs selected, every NVLink port of the server. Links that are down come first, then ports with errors, then the busiest.

Port: the NVSwitch port, and the GPU and link at its other end. When that GPU stopped reporting, the GPU and link the port reached when last seen in the past 7 days, marked last known.

Link: whether the connection is up.

Traffic: data currently going through the port in its busier direction, so that it compares with Bandwidth. Not reported means the port has no traffic counter.

Traffic Trend: Traffic over the selected period, capped at Bandwidth so that a counter glitch does not flatten the rest of the line.

Bandwidth: maximum speed of the connection in one direction. N/A when the port does not report it.

Utilization: Traffic as a share of Bandwidth. Near 100% the link is saturated and holds back the jobs that use it. N/A means the bandwidth or the traffic of the link is not known.

Errors: number of transmission errors on the port over the selected period. Not reported means the port has no error counter.

spec.expr:

spec.title: GPUs
spec.description:
The selected GPUs and how they are set up.

Memory: the GPU's own memory. Power Limit: the most power the GPU is allowed to draw.

PCIe Gen and PCIe Width: the speed and the number of lanes of the GPU's connection to the server right now, beside the most the GPU supports. Many GPUs lower the speed when idle to save power, but fewer lanes than the maximum means a slower connection.

Max Operating: temperature above which the GPU may start slowing itself down. Slowdown: temperature at which the hardware cuts its clocks.

MIG Instances: the number of slices the GPU is split into.

UUID: the GPU's unique identifier, which job schedulers also report.

A column that no GPU reports is not shown, for example a figure the connector does not publish yet.
